question: _________(ODOP) aims to reap the benefit of scale in terms of procurement of inputs, availing common services and marketing of products.
solution:
The correct answer is __**One District One Product.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One District One Product **(ODOP) is a scheme launched by the **Government of India** to promote** traditional and indigenous products** of each district, with the aim of boosting **employment and income generation **at the local level.
 
• ODOP aims to leverage the potential of each district by identifying **one unique product **for which the district has a comparative advantage, and then providing support for its **development, branding, marketing, and export**.
 
• This will not only create** local jobs** but also enhance the **national economy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All **761 districts **across the **nation's selection process **yielded over a thousand products.
 
• **Textiles, agriculture, processed goods, pharmaceuticals, and industrial products** are just a few of the many industries that are covered by the initiative.
 
• Additionally, a number of ODOP products were on display at the** Davos World Economic Forum in Switzerland **in **January 2023** in the Indian Pavilion.
